def solve_acopf(case: Dict) -> Dict:
    """
    Solve ACOPF
    :param case:
    :return:
    """
    if GUROBI_OPTIMODS_AVAILABLE:
        res = opf.solve_opf(case, opftype="AC")
        return res
    else:
        raise ImportError("No gurobi optimization available")
